brief: Several separate close dry Foley impacts of a blunt wooden staff striking a thick piece of raw animal hide over a heavy soft body. Short low solid thuds, a little damp contact, distinct quiet gaps between hits. One isolated physical source.

Several separate releases of a primitive wooden self bow. Brief wooden limb flex and tight plant fibre bowstring twang, fast dry elastic snap with a short decay, distinct quiet gaps. Close isolated Foley recording.
Several separate fast swings of a long thin wooden spear through still air. Short clean airy swishes, distinct quiet gaps. Close isolated dry Foley recording.

Several separate strikes of a small stone axe into a dry hardwood branch. Solid woody knocks and crisp splintering cracks, small chips, short dry decay, distinct quiet gaps. Close isolated Foley recording.

Several separate short strokes of a wooden digging stick levering into firm crumbly soil. Coarse earthy scrapes, dull little thumps and grains falling, distinct quiet gaps. Close isolated dry Foley recording.

Several separate gentle pulls and shifts of a dry plant fibre cord and knotted net in bare hands. Soft close fibrous rubbing, faint dry creaks and rustling, distinct quiet gaps. Isolated dry Foley recording.
